name: Claims Audit Gate
pass_criteria: docs/architecture/claims/<YYYY-MM-DD>-claims.md exists, written by claims-auditor in a fresh context
Every claim of class figure is sourced and dated, re-derived by command, or marked [UNVERIFIED] or [OPEN] in the artifact
Zero affiliation, social-proof or personal-data claims remain without a linked, verifiable record (SOUL.md R2, R3, R6)
At least three cited URLs per provider note were re-fetched this session; status claims such as renamed, archived or GA were checked
The eval harness was re-run and its pass and fail counts match 06-evals/rubric.md
git status --porcelain shows the auditor wrote only inside its write scope
notes: Extends gate.verify from AI Architect. The auditor re-derives and records; it never repairs.
